lines.en: Chest-legs drag furrows in the snow.

lines.zh: 我不是活物，是造出来的。
lines.en: I'm not alive; I was built.
My spiked shell shudders, shedding snow.
Ice crunches under me.

lines.zh: 走到哪，雪地就留一道痕。
lines.en: Wherever I go, a trail in the snow.
I shuffle along, clumsy.

lines.zh: 雪原上，我是块会动的箱子。
lines.en: On the snowfield, a moving chest.
My latch clicks as I move.

lines.zh: 里面装的东西，不给人看。
lines.en: What's inside stays hidden.
I follow the shoreline.
Snow gets in my seams; I still go.

lines.zh: 身子歪了一下，又正回来。
lines.en: I tilt, then straighten.
Frost thickens on my spikes.
I skirt the ice holes.
Each step feels weighed.
I keep walking, all the same.
I halt in the snow, dead still.
Latch shut — no one opens me.
Spikes meet the wind and split it.

lines.zh: 雪落在我身上，堆了一层。
lines.en: Snow settles and stacks on me.
I make no breathing sound.

lines.zh: 里面的东西轻轻撞了一下。
lines.en: Something inside knocks once.
I hear the sea far off.
I stand like a reef rock.
Cold means nothing to me.

lines.zh: 我在等什么，自己也不清楚。
lines.en: I wait, though I don't know for what.
The coral on my shell still glows.

lines.zh: 海嗣的造物，不需要休息。
lines.en: A seaborn construct needs no rest.
My latch was sealed by the seaborn.
Snow weighs the spikes but bends none.
You stand at my latch and won't move on.
This chest isn't for you.
My spikes face you.
Reach out and I pull in.
You can't guess what's inside.

lines.zh: 红石的微光，从缝里漏出。
lines.en: Redstone light leaks from my seam.

lines.zh: 海嗣给了我壳，没给我脸。
lines.en: The seaborn gave me a shell, not a face.
Open me? Try it.
I watch you with my whole box.
Only the two of us on the snow.

lines.zh: 闷闷一记，落在我箱盖上。
lines.en: A dull blow lands on my lid.
One spike snapped off at the base.
The chest rocks, then settles.
A crack creeps from the corner.
What's inside jolts.
I don't cry out; I retreat.
My latch is bent.
That broke my shell's face.
I slowly turn my spiked shell aside.
Constructs break too.
I don't eat; I guard.
I need none of what you hold.
Temptation does nothing to a chest.

lines.zh: 你把东西放我旁边，我也不开。
lines.en: Set it beside me; I still won't open.

lines.zh: 我这壳里，装的是别的东西。
lines.en: My shell holds something else.
Wave it about; I stay put.
No stomach, no mouth.
Put it away; the snowfield has no use for it.

lines.zh: 这点东西，换不开我的锁。
lines.en: That won't undo my latch.

lines.zh: 我这锁扣不是为这种事开的。
lines.en: This latch doesn't open for such things.
Hit me and the spikes reach you first.
I'm heavy; pushing does nothing.
The hit buries my corner in the snow.
My latch rattles, still shut.
We've trampled the snow to slush.

lines.zh: 你退开的时候，刺勾住了衣角。
lines.en: As you pulled back, a spike caught your coat.
I don't step aside.
Consider that a reef.
I turn in place.
My shell is harder than you.
Constructs have no companions.
Only snow beside me.
Another like me? I've never seen one.

lines.zh: 锁对锁，也没什么好说的。
lines.en: Latch to latch — nothing to say.

lines.zh: 海嗣造我的时候，是单个造的。
lines.en: The seaborn made me one at a time.
I need no company.

lines.zh: 雪落在我们之间，也没人擦。
lines.en: Snow falls between us, and no one brushes it.
This shell can't hold affection.
I am only a chest.
Not too close; the spikes bite.

lines.zh: 雪里的东西，我夹进壳里。
lines.en: I tuck what's in the snow into my shell.
The redstone ingot was mine already.
Chitin shards — I keep them.
I close my lid; no one takes it.
I do it without a sound.

lines.zh: 东西进了壳，就不出来了。
lines.en: In my shell, it never comes out.
I glide a short way with it clamped.
A coral fan jams in my seam.
I pick things up by shutting my lid.
A fish scale — into the shell.
Something entered my range.
Within thirty paces, I know.
My spiked shell has turned your way.
You're not seaborn.
Marked; don't come near.
My latch rattles — a warning.
I shift one slow step.

lines.zh: 雪上有你的脚印，我看得见。
lines.en: Your tracks show in the snow.
This snowfield is mine to guard.
Leave, or take the spikes.

lines.zh: 雪上那道沟一直跟着你。
lines.en: That furrow in the snow follows you.
Slow, but I don't stop.

lines.zh: 雪面会把你的脚步交出来。
lines.en: The snow gives up your footsteps.
You look back; I halt.
My spikes aim your way.

lines.zh: 你敢再挪半步，我就压过去。
lines.en: One more half-step and I bear down on you.

lines.zh: 没有呼吸，所以你听不见。
lines.en: No breath, so you hear nothing.

lines.zh: 我蹭着雪皮，一点点挪近。
lines.en: I scrape over the crust, closing inch by inch.
The more you run, the clearer the trail.
In this cold, you won't last.
The whole chest slams forward!
My spiked shell presses; no escape.
I don't punch; I drop all of me.
Coral edges cut too.
I hit you and rock myself.
That will put you ten paces back.
My lid snaps open and shut.
A spike catches in your armor.
I come down with nothing but my weight.
Again; I don't tire.
A chest rises from the snow.
Ice still hangs on my spikes.
I land on the snowy beach.
My latch clicks; I wake.

lines.zh: 海嗣的手，把我放在这里。
lines.en: Seaborn hands set me here.
The white stretches with no edge.
I turn halfway to find my bearings.
Snow layers off me.
I drag my feet into the woods.

lines.zh: 守着吧，反正也没别的事。
lines.en: I'll guard; there's nothing else.
Fire bakes my shell; the wood chars.

lines.zh: 我摔下来，箱底先砸进雪里。
lines.en: I come down and my base drives into the snow.

lines.zh: 水漫过锁扣，里面进了水。
lines.en: Water rises past my latch and seeps in.
The blast scatters fragments.
An arrow wedges between spikes.
That force swirls inside my shell.

lines.zh: 我不吃东西，只是壳在朽。
lines.en: I don't eat; my shell just rots.

lines.zh: 雷劈在刺上，我整只发麻。
lines.en: Lightning hits a spike; I go numb.
I fall, the chest tumbling.
